_rule: Every var(--name) with no fallback names a custom property declared in a stylesheet the page loads, or it is listed here by file and name with its count and a reason. The count is exact, so a new site of a listed name still fails.

--swatch-color.reason: Not dangling: AccountMenu.jsx declares it per swatch through an inline style prop, which the gate cannot see because only .css files contribute declarations.

--cx-accent-h.reason: Set on the root by userPrefs.js (applyPrefsToDOM) when an accent is picked, so codex.css reads it under [data-accent]; the gate reads only stylesheets, so it cannot see the JavaScript that declares it.
